title: Split 10->2 (1 share becomes 5) before a partial long-term sale; cost and holding period carry over from the original purchase
rules: Sub-division of shares (Companies Act 2013 s.61(1)(d)) is not an acquisition of a new asset: original cost is spread over the new number of shares and the period of holding runs from the original purchase (settled practice; no specific clause in s.2(42A)/s.55 - see INDEX.md)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso: listed equity long-term if held more than 12 months
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % above Rs 1,25,000 for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
derivation: Split 2024-03-15 face value 10 -> 2: ratio 10/2 = 5 -> 100 x 5 = 500 shares; cost per share 1,000 / 5 = 200.00; acquisition date stays 2023-02-01.
